# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 33 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_010_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 10

**1** Jesus said: "I have cast [нопт] fire [кавс] upon the world [космос], and look, I am guarding [аре] it until it blazes [рхм]."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *кавс*: fire; Greek loan-word (καῦσις/καύσω)
- *нопт*: to throw, cast — same verb as the sower casting seed (Saying 9); verbal echo
- *космос*: world; Greek loan-word
- *аре*: to guard, watch, keep — present tense of ongoing activity
- *рхм*: to blaze, ignite; the fire is cast but not yet fully burning; Jesus watches over it
- cf. Luke 12:49: "I came to cast fire upon the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!" — close parallel
- Thomas is shorter and lacks the wishing-formula; the fire is already cast and being watched

---
